profile.name: Satendra Goswami
profile.headline: Web Developer · IT Support Engineer · LMS & Online Exam Platforms
profile.intro: I build web applications, from online exam platforms to real-time chat, on top of 8+ years of hands-on IT experience with servers, databases and platforms used by 5,000+ people.
profile.availability: Open to web development & IT roles
profile.caption: Who is Satendra?
profile.about:
I'm a web developer with a strong IT foundation. I design and build web applications that solve real problems, such as AttendanceIQ for Zoom attendance, Quizify for online exams and VartaApp for real-time chat, and I bring 8+ years of hands-on experience in technical support, system administration, LMS administration and online examination platforms.

At Team Computers, I support TimesPro and IIM Indore, administering the LMS, resolving learner issues through Salesforce ticketing, supporting live Zoom sessions for IIM faculty, configuring online exams on Mettl and maintaining studio broadcast systems.

Earlier roles at Flipkart, CF Technologies & Aptech, NGRT Systems (Apple Authorized Service Center) and Bitla Software gave me a strong base in remote support, Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS, LAMP, LAN networking and hardware troubleshooting. I have also worked with AWS, I'm comfortable on Linux, I have worked across all commonly used versions of Windows, and I use macOS Tahoe as my primary system.

I have supported 5,000+ users and worked on 200+ government assessment projects, including command-centre operations for the Rajasthan Police, UPPCL and AIIMS Nursing examinations.

My biggest strength is R&D: give me an unfamiliar task and I'll research it, learn what's needed and get it done. I also look for smarter ways of working, I enjoy turning ideas into practical tools that simplify repetitive work. I’ve designed and built projects such as AttendanceIQ and Quizify based on my own concepts, using modern development tools and AI to turn ideas into working solutions quickly. I’m particularly interested in building SaaS products that automate repetitive tasks, improve productivity, and help teams get more work done in less time.
profile.ctaTitle: Have a project or a role in mind?
profile.ctaText: I'm open to web development and IT roles, and to building web apps that save teams time. Tell me what you need and I'll get back to you.

projects.name: AttendanceIQ
projects.description: A web tool for schools, colleges, universities, and organizations running online Zoom classes that need accurate attendance. The problem: during a Zoom class, learners join late, leave early, disconnect, and rejoin. Working out by hand who attended "enough" time is slow and error-prone. The solution: upload your Zoom participant report → configure sessions and rules → download an attendance report with Present/Absent status and shortfall details.
projects.tags: Python, Web App, Zoom Reports, Excel

projects.name: Quizify
projects.description: Converts quiz documents in almost any format, Word, PDF, spreadsheets, web pages, plain text, or photos into structured questions and exports them to Excel, CSV, or JSON. It also includes AI-assisted processing, an admin panel, question bank, student portal, online exam management, auto-grading, and live proctoring. Designed around my interest in simplifying assessment workflows, reducing repetitive tasks, and making quiz creation and exam management faster and more efficient.
projects.tags: Python, AI-assisted Parsing, Online Exams, Proctoring

projects.name: VartaApp — Chat App
projects.description: A modern, WhatsApp-inspired real-time chat application built with React 19, Firebase, and Redux Toolkit, featuring secure authentication, one-to-one and group messaging, read receipts, typing indicators, message editing, emoji support, profile management, and responsive desktop and mobile experiences. It also includes a dedicated admin dashboard with user management, role-based permissions, broadcast messaging, and conversation monitoring. Designed around my interest in building modern communication platforms with real-time functionality, clean UI, and practical administrative controls.
